# Slider

Select value from range

## Overview

- **Category**: inputs
- **Base Library**: mui
- **MUI Component**: Slider

## Installation

```bash
npm install @lsy-netline/netline-ui
```

## Import

```typescript
import { Slider } from '@lsy-netline/netline-ui';
```

## Basic Usage

```tsx
<Slider
  defaultValue={50}
  marks
  min={0}
  max={100}
  step={10}
/>
```

## Examples

```tsx
<Slider
  defaultValue={50}
  marks
  min={0}
  max={100}
  step={10}
/>
```

## MUI Reference

This component is based on Material-UI's Slider.

For additional props and detailed API documentation, refer to:

- [MUI Slider Documentation](https://mui.com/material-ui/api/slider/)
